facts.text: Under the Sycamore Graduation Guarantee, Indiana State University will pay tuition and mandatory fees for remaining courses if an eligible student is unable to complete their degree in four years.

sources.title: Sycamore Graduation Guarantee | Indiana State University
sources.quote: If students approved for the Guarantee adhere to the Student Responsibilities but are unable to complete the primary degree on time, Indiana State University will pay the tuition and mandatory fees for any remaining courses to complete the degree.
